entities.name: Query CdaS
observations: The 201-residue query sequence is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein D5TM67, annotated as diadenylate cyclase CdaS.
Pfam evidence identifies CdaS_N (PF10372) at residues 1–69 and DAC (PF02457) at residues 78–194.
The enzyme requires Mg2+ according to the matched reviewed annotation.

entities.name: c-di-AMP synthesis
observations: The catalyzed reaction is 2 ATP → 3′,3′-cyclic di-AMP + 2 diphosphate.
The reaction is assigned EC 2.7.7.85 and Rhea RHEA:35655.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Mg2+ is listed as a cofactor for the matched CdaS diadenylate cyclase.
